name: Fürstenau (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and green, charged at the centre with the city arms of Fürstenau (a white castle on red).
history: Municipal flag of Fürstenau; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Fürstenau arms — white castle on red
